## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works and focus is visible
- [ ] Responsive checked at 360 / 768 / 1280 px
- [ ] Both `es` and `en` content updated (no mixed-language output)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, ID documents, signatures or client data included
- [ ] No private repository URLs exposed
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visible changes
